Run a command or program before Minecraft starts. The syntax follows the Windows command prompt.

Use replacement tokens to make the command dynamic or use relative paths. Search for “replacement tokens” under More → Help for details.
Examples:
 · "{verpath}test.exe": run test.exe in the version folder
 · notepad "{verindie}options.txt": open this version's settings file in Notepad

Quote paths to avoid failures when they contain spaces.
Commands run with the current .minecraft folder as their working directory.
